name: Préparatrice des lots
description: Lean elder adult female with weathered olive skin, long pale dreadlocks bound near tips, fine angled mandibles, simple bronze protective goggles on forehead. Sand wrap shirt with long sleeves, knee-length pocketed apron, worn leather shoulder harness. Holds a small wooden-and-bronze divided supply box showing closed capsules, other hand steadies a tied cloth bundle. Slight careful forward lean.
